results.answer: VPN Authentication Failed – Quick Fixes (English): 1️⃣ Make sure your internet works without the VPN (open any website). 2️⃣ Verify that the date & time on your laptop are correct; a wrong clock can break the VPN certificate check. 3️⃣ Fully quit the VPN client, then restart it and sign in with your company email. 4️⃣ If it still says **authentication failed**, your password may have expired. Follow the password‑reset runbook (use the “Forgot password” link on the login screen). 5️⃣ Try connecting from another network (e.g., your phone’s hotspot). If it works there, your home router might be blocking the VPN port.  If none of these steps resolve the issue, let me know and I’ll open a ticket for you (category network, priority medium).

results.answer: Here are the safe steps to free disk space on a Docker host, based on the runbook for a full Linux server disk: 1️⃣ Check what’s using space: run `df -h` to see overall usage, then `sudo du -xh / --max-depth=2 | sort -h | tail -20` to list the largest directories. 2️⃣ Review Docker usage: run `docker system df` to see space consumed by images, containers, volumes, and build cache. 3️⃣ Prune unused Docker objects: • `docker image prune` – removes dangling images. • `docker volume prune` – removes unused volumes. • `docker container prune` – removes stopped containers. **Never** use `docker system prune -a` on a production host without explicit approval, as it will delete all images. 4️⃣ Clean old system logs: `sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=7d` (keeps logs from the last 7 days). Verify that `logrotate` is configured for any application logs. 5️⃣ If a service has stopped because the disk is full, escalate: open a ticket (category server, priority critical) so the team can verify service health.These steps should free space safely without removing critical data. If you need further help or a ticket opened, let me know!

results.answer: Here are the steps from the runbook to fix a slow laptop (you can follow them in English or Arabic): Arabic: 1. أعد تشغيل اللابتوب (لا تضعه في السكون)؛ فغالباً اللابتوبات البطيئة التي لم تُعاد weeks. 2. افتح Task Manager وفرِّع العمليات حسب الذاكرة، وأغِّر البرامج وعلامات التبويب التي لا تستخدمها. 3. تحقق من مساحة القرص الحرة؛ إذا كانت أقل من 10% ممتلئة، فهذا يجعل كل شيء بطيئاً. 4. قم بتثبيت التحديثات المعلَّقة، ثم أعد التشغيل مرة أخرى. إذا ظلت المشكلة بعد هذه الخطوات، افتح تذكرة (القسم Hardware، الأولوية Low) فقد تحتاج إلى ذاكرة إضافية أو قرص جديد. English: 1. Restart the laptop (not sleep); many slow laptops have not restarted in weeks. 2. Open Task Manager and sort by memory; close browser tabs and apps you are not using. 3. Check free disk space; under 10% free makes everything slow. 4. Install pending updates, then restart again. If it is still slow after these steps, open a ticket (category hardware, priority low) - it may need more memory or a new disk.

Here’s what to do when your company password stops working: 1. From the login screen click **Forgot password** (or the self‑service reset link). The system will send a reset code to the phone number we have on file. 2. Follow the link in the text message or email and create a new password that is at least 12 characters long and does **not** reuse any of your last 5 passwords. 3. After the reset, go to your phone’s mail (or any other app that uses the corporate account) and update the saved password, otherwise the account may lock again. 4. If your account is locked, wait about 15 minutes – it unlocks automatically. Do **not** keep trying, as each failed attempt restarts the timer. 5. If you don’t have access to the registered phone or the reset link isn’t working, let me know and I’ll open an access‑category ticket for you. **Never share your password in chat or email**; the helpdesk will never ask for it.
